symptom: check passed and exec wrote a user task with six boundary events; mx check 11.12.4 then reports CE6696 'An activity is not allowed to have more than 5 boundary events.'
cause: No rule bounded the number of boundary events per activity.
fix: MDL-WF23 counts boundary events per activity in CREATE WORKFLOW and in the activities an ALTER adds, plus an ALTER's inserts per activity; the workflow mutator refuses an insert onto an activity that already stores five (only it knows the stored count). Limit is workflows.MaxBoundaryEventsPerActivity.
insight: A limit on a stored collection needs two checks: a static one over what the statement writes, and one at the mutator for what is already there; the static check alone misses `insert into X { boundary event … }` on an activity with five.
